law.catch_line: Litter Control and Recycling Fund Advisory Board established; duties and responsibilities
law.text:
There is hereby created the Litter Control and Recycling Fund Advisory Board. The Advisory Board shall:
Review applications received by the Department for grants from the Fund and make recommendations to the Director for the award of all grants authorized pursuant to § 10.1-1422.01;
Promote the control, prevention and elimination of litter from the Commonwealth and encourage the recycling of discarded materials to the maximum practical extent; and
Advise the Director on such other litter control and recycling matters as may be requested by the Director or any other state agency.
